title: Virginia Beach True Crime Tour
includes: Tour of Virginia Beach's most infamous true crime cases
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Take a walk on the dark side and explore the tales of the most infamous murders, crimes, and mayhem in Virginia Beach. From terrifying serial killers to the city’s struggles during the “crime wave” of the ’70s, and the crime that “ended the hitchhiking era”, learn about all these and more on the true crime tour.
